description: The EntityQuery class provides a fluent API for constructing and executing entity database queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It supports setting query options like select fields, entity to query, where conditions, order, caching, pagination, and date filtering. The class offers methods for executing queries, retrieving counts, and fetching results in various forms such as lists, iterators, and paged lists.

classes.name: EntityQuery
classes.description: A utility class enabling construction and execution of complex entity database queries with a fluent API, supporting features like field selection, filtering, ordering, caching, pagination, and date filtering.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Factory method to create an EntityQuery instance for a specified Delegator.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Sets the fields to be returned in the query result; replaces any previous selection.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Specifies the entity or dynamic view entity to query against.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Sets the WHERE condition for the query, replacing previous conditions.

methods.name: having
methods.description: Sets the HAVING condition for the query, replacing previous ones.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Defines the ordering of the result set, replacing previous order instructions.

methods.name: cursorForwardOnly
methods.description: Sets the result set to be forward-only.

methods.name: cursorScrollSensitive
methods.description: Sets the result set to be scroll-sensitive.

methods.name: cursorScrollInsensitive
methods.description: Sets the result set to be scroll-insensitive.

methods.name: fetchSize
methods.description: Specifies the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: maxRows
methods.description: Limits the maximum number of rows returned.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Sets the starting offset for the query results.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to return.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Indicates whether to eliminate duplicate results.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Enables or disables result caching.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters results by active date range at the current moment.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters results by active date range at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters results by active date range at a specific Date object.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters results by active date range using specified from/thru field name pairs.

methods.name: queryList
methods.description: Executes the constructed query and returns a list of results.

methods.name: queryIterator
methods.description: Executes the query and returns an iterator over the results; must be closed after use.

methods.name: queryBatchIterator
methods.description: Returns a batch iterator for large result sets.

methods.name: queryFirst
methods.description: Executes the query and returns the first result.

methods.name: queryOne
methods.description: Executes the query expecting exactly one result.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of matching entities; throws if multiple results exist.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of values for a specific entity field, without caching issues.

methods.name: queryPagedList
methods.description: Returns a subset of data as a paged list based on view index and size.
